title: SaaS Development
description: We build scalable SaaS platforms from zero to production, with modern maintainable architecture built to grow. Every project includes robust role-based authentication, integrated billing (Stripe), a complete admin dashboard, and automated CI/CD pipelines. Full technical documentation is included. We guide you from initial concept to a live, paying-customer-ready product — handling every phase of the build.

title: Mobile Applications
description: We develop high-quality iOS and Android apps using React Native or Flutter, sharing a single codebase to cut development time without sacrificing quality. From prototyping to store submission, every app is built for native performance, a polished UX, and seamless push notification delivery. All apps are tested on real devices before release to guarantee a smooth user experience from day one.
features: iOS + Android from a single codebase

title: Landing Pages & Websites
description: We create high-performance landing pages and institutional websites designed to turn visitors into leads and customers. Every project is mobile-first, fast-loading, and SEO-optimized from the ground up. We handle professional design, lead capture forms, Google Analytics setup, and technical on-page SEO — so you get a website that doesn't just look good, but actively drives business results.

title: E-Commerce Stores
description: We build complete e-commerce stores with product catalog, shopping cart, optimized checkout, and payment gateway integration (Stripe, PayPal). Inventory management, a sales dashboard, and automated order and shipping notifications are included out of the box. Every store is designed for conversion and built to scale as your business grows. Multi-currency and multi-language support available.

title: Dashboards & Admin Panels
description: We build intuitive B2B dashboards and admin panels that turn raw data into decisions. Real-time charts, exportable reports, and custom KPIs tailored to your operations give your team full visibility over business performance. Advanced filters, PDF and CSV exports, and automated alerts on critical metrics mean your team always knows what's happening — without digging through spreadsheets.

title: APIs & Integrations
description: We design and build robust, well-documented REST and GraphQL APIs, and integrate your systems with ERPs, CRMs, payment gateways, and any external platform you rely on. Business process automation via webhooks and event-driven architecture reduces manual work at scale. All APIs include full OpenAPI documentation, a sandbox environment for safe testing, and OAuth2 or API key authentication.

title: AI Automation
description: We build custom AI agents, intelligent chatbots, and automation workflows powered by OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and open-source models. The goal is concrete: increase team output, lower operational costs, and eliminate repetitive processes at scale. Every solution ships with a monitoring dashboard so you can track performance, catch edge cases, and continuously improve the system over time.
features: Custom AI agent for your workflow

title: Marketplace Platforms
description: We develop complete two-sided marketplace platforms with vendor onboarding, configurable commission splits, order management, reviews, and separate control panels for operators and sellers. Everything you need to launch and grow: automated payouts, real-time analytics, fraud prevention hooks, and notifications for buyers and sellers at every step of the transaction flow.

title: Custom ERP Systems
description: We build ERP systems tailored to your actual business processes — not off-the-shelf software you need to adapt to. Financial management, HR, inventory, production, CRM, and executive reports in one integrated platform. The system is modular and scalable, growing with your company. Existing supplier integrations and team training are included in the delivery process.

title: Chatbots & Customer Support
description: We build intelligent chatbots for WhatsApp Business, Telegram, and web with conversational AI, CRM integration, and seamless human handoff when the situation calls for it. Automate first-line support, qualify inbound leads, and make sure no customer request goes unanswered — 24 hours a day. A conversation analytics dashboard lets you monitor interactions and refine responses over time.

title: Technical Consulting
description: We provide technical consulting for software architecture design, technology stack selection, in-depth code reviews, legacy system migration, and developer team mentoring. Every engagement produces a concrete deliverable — a detailed architecture report, a migration plan, or a technology roadmap — so your team walks away with a clear path forward, not just verbal recommendations.
features: Code review with prioritized action items

title: Desktop Applications
description: We build cross-platform desktop applications that run on Windows, macOS, and Linux from a single Electron codebase. Offline-first support with background synchronization, local hardware integration (printers, barcode scanners, card readers), and automatic over-the-air updates are standard. Ideal for enterprise tools that need direct access to operating system resources or work in environments with unreliable connectivity.
features: Windows + macOS + Linux from one codebase
